description: This file defines the interface ITestClusterPortAllocator within the Orleans.TestingHost namespace. It specifies methods for allocating unused network ports for testing clusters, including allocating consecutive port pairs.

classes.name: ITestClusterPortAllocator
classes.description: An interface for allocating unused ports for testing Orleans clusters. It includes a method to allocate a specified number of consecutive port pairs.

methods.name: AllocateConsecutivePortPairs
methods.description: Allocates a number of consecutive port pairs for use by the test cluster, returning their base ports.
